question.text: All AIFs investing in listed equities must mandatorily follow which code as per SEBI Circular dated December 24, 2019?

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.5 Point 13: SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 dated December 24, 2019 mandates Stewardship Code for Mutual Funds and ALL AIFs in relation to investment in listed equities. Requires periodic reporting to SEBI, clients and beneficiaries. The Trap: Options A, C, D are separate regimes not specific to AIF stewardship. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C (Compliance) covers Stewardship Code in detail; XIX-C requires the IM to implement internal controls. Manager's Pro-Tip: Adopt the AMFI/SEBI stewardship template verbatim, then customize for private-equity-style voting in investee companies. Annual Stewardship report must be published on the fund website and filed with SEBI — calendar the deadline.
